ooxmlSizeReductionMechanism.explanation: The massive DOCX size reductions (77-86%) observed in BM-031, BM-052, BM-062 are explained by OOXML serializer overhead compression, NOT content loss. DOCX files are ZIP archives containing XML files. The original files likely had: (1) redundant namespace declarations, (2) empty XML elements (empty <w:r/>, <w:p/>), (3) redundant style references, (4) unused XML attributes, (5) XML pretty-printing whitespace. OOXML serializers (LibreOffice, python-docx, normalize-docx-format.mjs) strip these automatically during save, resulting in 4-7x compression without content loss.
